title: Cicada 3301 as an intelligence recruitment puzzle
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Cicada 3301 as an intelligence recruitment puzzle, about 2014 at internet, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And a lot of people think that the whole puzzle was set up by the NSA or CIA and it was like a recruitment tool.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about Cicada 3301, a mysterious puzzle that circulated on the internet around 2014. He says that many people think it was set up by the NSA, America's code-breaking and eavesdropping agency, or by the CIA, its foreign intelligence agency, as a way to find and recruit clever people.
